effects.prompt: Tap Magmatic Carapace and pay {r} to create a Seismic Surge token?

_comment: Guardwell is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field; deliberately NOT authored here. STATIC_TRIGGERED with ON_CARD_PLAYED triggers whenever any card is played. CARD_IS_TYPE with types ['Aura'] filters for aura cards. MAY block with cost [TAP_SELF, PAY_RESOURCES amount 1] offers the optional tap + pay {r} (both required per release note: 'you must be able to both tap Magmatic Carapace and pay {r}'). If accepted, CREATE_TOKEN creates a Seismic Surge token. ENGINE GAP: ON_CARD_PLAYED is currently only dispatched to the player's hero (_dsl_card_played_listener in engine.py), not to equipment/permanents. This ability will not fire until the engine dispatches ON_CARD_PLAYED to all relevant permanents (similar to START_OF_ACTION_PHASE listener).
